name: ARN Smart AI-Powered Site Utilities for Elementor
author: arnsmart

sections.description:
ARN Smart AI-Powered Site Utilities for Elementor is a free WordPress plugin that adds 33 Elementor widgets, a header and footer builder, SEO and schema markup, reusable company information, 3,800 icons, practical WooCommerce tools and review-first AI media to your Elementor site – in one plugin, with no license key.

Instead of five or six add-ons, you get one workspace: company details entered once appear everywhere, headers and footers follow display rules, and AI image names and alt text wait for your review. Optional modules stay off until you turn them on.

✨ Why Site Utilities?

  • One plugin instead of many – one settings area, one design system.
  • Ready in about five minutes – Guided Setup, undone with one click.
  • Loads only what you use – icon styles load by pack and the news style sheet only with news widgets on.
  • Your data stays on your site – no ARN account or license server, nothing sent to ARN.
  • AI you control – your own AI provider; nothing is saved before you review it.
  • Built for every visitor – responsive, right-to-left ready and accessibility-aware output.

🧩 33 Elementor widgets

Widgets sit in the ARN Smart Site Utilities Elementor category and start with sample content, so pages look finished before editing.

  • Page building: headings, text, hero slider, buttons, CTA, counters, feature blocks, timelines and pricing tables.
  • Trust and contact: testimonials, team members, logo carousel, rating badge, company information, contact cards, business hours and ARN Form.
  • Site parts: navigation menu, header search, header tools, site logo, breadcrumbs and announcement bar.
  • Content and news: post grid, FAQ, responsive image, release notes and three optional news widgets.

The FAQ lists every widget.

🧱 Header & Footer Builder

Build headers and footers under ARN Utilities → Header & Footer without a page builder template.

  • Rows and columns with logo, menus, search, buttons, contact, social, account, cart, copyright and more.
  • Display rules with exclusions, sticky and transparent headers, a mobile panel and live preview.
  • Each page, post or product can choose its own header and footer.

📈 SEO, Schema & Visibility Engine

Off until an administrator enables it; next to another active SEO plugin it can run as an analyzer only.

  • Metadata: SEO title, meta description, canonical, robots, focus phrases, Open Graph and X cards with a social preview.
  • Content analysis: reads the rendered page (Elementor, Gutenberg, Classic Editor, shortcodes) with a readiness score and recommendations.
  • Connected JSON-LD Schema: WebSite, Organization or LocalBusiness, WebPage, Article, Service, Product, BreadcrumbList and FAQPage.
  • XML sitemap: chosen post types and taxonomies; noindex and password-protected content is left out.

These tools improve content structure and machine understanding; they do not promise rankings or AI citations.

🏢 Company Information, shortcodes and Dynamic Tags

Enter company, contact, legal and social data once under ARN Utilities → Company Data and reuse it in widgets, shortcodes and Elementor Dynamic Tags. Change a value once and every page that uses it updates. The FAQ lists every field, shortcode and Dynamic Tag.

🎨 Design System and ARN Smart Icon Manager

  • Design System: brand colors and fonts for ARN widgets or the whole site; Google fonts are served from your own site.
  • 3,800 unique, font-free SVG-mask icons in Default Icons (1,181) and Interface Essentials (2,994) that take the Elementor color.
  • Icon search and a personal My Icons selection; Elementor’s own and Font Awesome libraries remain available.

🤖 AI Media Intelligence

Optional, disabled by default and preview-first.

  • Filename, title, slug and alt-text suggestions, one by one or in batches.
  • Renames keep content references and Elementor styles in sync; every change can be restored.
  • Optional alt text for new uploads; low-confidence suggestions go to review.

AI runs through Settings → ARN Free AI, shared by ARN Free plugins: WordPress AI (WordPress 7.0+) or your own API key for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, xAI Grok, Mistral or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Keys are stored encrypted. Without AI, suggestions come from the file name and context. If ARN Smart WebPix (Pro) manages media AI, it takes over.

🛒 WooCommerce Tools

With WooCommerce active; each tool is off by default.

  • Store Type: Physical, Virtual, Digital or Mixed; the product editor adapts.
  • Product Identifiers & Cost: MPN, Barcode/GTIN, GTIP, Manufacturer, Supplier and three cost fields, plus a live, tax-aware profit margin never shown to customers.
  • Quantity Discounts: tiers such as “5 or more: 10% off” in the classic and block cart.
  • Order Limits: minimum and maximum quantities and amounts per product, category or cart.
  • Customer Order Changes: address change or cancellation before shipping.
  • Product Questions: questions and answers in a product tab.
  • Shipping on the Product Page: methods and costs for the customer’s address.
  • Product Interest: 30-day views and adds to cart, without cookies.
  • Pricing Zones: prices per country group, chosen by the visitor ([arnsmesu_zone_selector]), address or geolocation; payment stays in the store currency.

Product schema is skipped when a dedicated SEO plugin (Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress, AIOSEO, The SEO Framework) is active, so there is no duplicate.

🧰 Smart Features

Each is switched on under ARN Utilities → Smart Features:

  • Admin Notes: colored dashboard notes, personal or shared.
  • Draft Preview Links: secret, expiring draft links.
  • Search & Replace: database text or old addresses with a preview and undo; administrators only.
  • Disable Comments: stops new comments site-wide; existing comments are never touched.
  • Push Notifications: browser notifications when you publish, sent by your own site with Web Push (no service sign-up); iPhone and iPad (iOS 16.4+) from the Home Screen.
  • News Widgets: the three news widgets, read counts and correction notes.
  • Site Banner: an image banner via [arnsmesu_banner].
  • Quick Menu: admin shortcuts to filtered product or post lists.

🧭 Guided Setup

ARN Utilities → Setup opens after the first activation.

  • Pick Business, News & Magazine or Online Store to turn on the matching features.
  • Choose one of six palettes and four font pairs, enter company details, and optionally add sample pages, a menu, a header and a footer.
  • Undo setup restores earlier settings; posts, products, orders, existing pages and menus are never touched.

🎨 Best with the free Vendix Theme

ARN Smart AI-Powered Site Utilities for Elementor runs on other WordPress themes too. It is developed and tested with Vendix Theme, a free, lightweight Elementor base theme on WordPress.org – and the full fit is there: one design system, native header and footer places, site types, Guided Setup from the welcome page and store and news ready layouts.

Get Vendix Theme for free: wordpress.org/themes/vendix

🔒 Privacy, performance and your data

  • Deactivation never deletes settings, content or company information.
  • Updates come through WordPress.org, with no license key.
  • No ARN server is contacted; external services run only for features you turn on (see External services).
  • Data is removed only with the uninstall option on and the plugin deleted.

⭐ Go further with ARN Smart Vendix Pro

ARN Smart Vendix Pro, the professional Elementor framework for larger websites, includes everything in Free and adds:

  • More widgets (hero designs, sliders, tabs, countdowns, comparison tables, modals, hotspots) and more layouts.
  • The full newspaper set, the full Design System with the Elementor Kit, and advanced setup levels.
  • Form Guard, a Store Type scan-and-convert tool and other site tools.
  • Dynamic Content with listings and a demo gallery; quote and newsletter forms; push also via OneSignal or Firebase.
  • Store modules such as discount rules, quotes, delivery slots, returns and a profit report.
  • AEO / GEO / AIO analysis, E-E-A-T evidence checks and the Site Report.
  • License management, private Pro updates and priority support.

Site Utilities stays usable without a Vendix Pro license.

🔗 More from ARN Smart

Free on WordPress.org, usable alone or together:

  • ARN Smart AI-Powered Visitor Intent – visitor-intent capture, triggers, analytics and contact actions.
  • ARN Smart Image Optimizer – local WebP and AVIF image optimization.
  • ARN Smart Duplicate Post & Content Toolkit – controlled draft preparation, duplication and find and replace.
  • ARN Smart URL Manager – short links, redirects, QR codes and local analytics.

Pro editions with more power and priority support: Vendix, Visioix, WebPix, Clonex, Linkix, SiteWatch, Contix and DualFix. Explore all products at ARN Smart.

External services

AI Media (ARN Free AI). The plugin contacts no ARN server. AI stays off until an administrator chooses a provider and enters their own API key (stored encrypted in the database) under Settings > ARN Free AI; requests then go to that provider only.

Requests are sent only while Media Intelligence is enabled: when an administrator clicks AI Preview or Generate Selected Previews, or when automatic alt text (off by default) runs for a new upload. Sent data: the image (a copy of at most 4 MB, preferably a smaller WordPress size; SVG files are not sent) and its context: site name and tagline, file name and type, title, slug, current alt text, caption, a short description, the parent post title, the titles and short excerpts of up to three published posts that use the file, and the site language. “Test connection” (a fixed test prompt, no site content) and “Load models” (the provider’s model list) also contact the chosen provider when clicked. Nothing is sent while AI is not set up or while ARN Smart WebPix (Pro) manages media AI.

  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use , https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Anthropic (Claude): https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms , https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • DeepSeek: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html , https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
  • Moonshot AI (Kimi): https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/userprivacy
  • xAI (Grok): https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service , https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
  • Mistral AI: https://legal.mistral.ai/terms , https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/privacy-policy
  • OpenAI-compatible endpoint: the address the administrator enters, under that service’s own terms.

With WordPress AI, requests go through the provider connected in WordPress (Settings > Connectors) under that provider’s terms.

ARN Free AI keeps its settings in the arn_free_ai_settings option and daily usage totals (no prompts, answers or keys) in the {prefix}arn_free_ai_usage table.

Design System Google fonts. Only when an administrator picks a Google font for body or headings under ARN Utilities > Design System and saves, the server downloads it once: the stylesheet from fonts.googleapis.com and its WOFF2 files from fonts.gstatic.com (Latin, Latin Extended and Arabic, the Design System’s weights). Only the font family and weights are sent, no visitor or site data. The files are served from wp-content/uploads/arnsmesu-fonts, so visitors’ browsers never connect to Google. The font list comes from Elementor.

  • Google Fonts: https://developers.google.com/fonts/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy

Search & Replace. Only when an administrator uses it: “Find old addresses” sends one HTTP HEAD request for a sample file to each of at most 5 earlier site addresses found in the database, to see whether they still answer (no site data is sent); after a run or an undo, the plugin requests the site’s own home page once to detect a server or CDN page cache.

Guided Setup. Only when an administrator clicks “Install & activate” on the Plugins step of an online-store setup: WordPress’s own plugin installer downloads WooCommerce from WordPress.org, as under Plugins → Add Plugin. No other setup step uses an external service.

  • WordPress.org: https://wordpress.org/about/privacy/

Web push notifications. With Push Notifications on (Smart Features), your site itself sends each notification, encrypted, to the push service of the subscribed visitor’s browser, with no account or third-party notification service. The browser, not this plugin, picks the service:

  • Google Firebase Cloud Messaging (Chrome, Edge, Opera, Samsung Internet, Brave): https://fcm.googleapis.com — Terms: https://firebase.google.com/terms — Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Mozilla Push Service (Firefox): https://updates.push.services.mozilla.com — Terms: https://www.mozilla.org/about/legal/terms/services/ — Privacy: https://www.mozilla.org/privacy/firefox/
  • Apple Push Notification service (Safari, iPhone and iPad): https://web.push.apple.com — Privacy: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/
  • Microsoft Windows Push Notification Services (older Edge): https://*.notify.windows.com — Privacy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement

Requests are sent only when a notification goes out (a post published with “Send to subscribers when published” ticked, or a test), to the address the visitor’s browser gave when subscribing. Each carries the notification (title, text, link, image address) encrypted for that browser only, a time to live, and a signed header with your site’s public key and your site address or contact e-mail. The plugin sends no visitor IP address or other visitor personal data. Nothing is sent while the feature is off.

The Header & Footer Builder, Admin Notes, Draft Preview Links, Social Sharing Preview, ARN Form and news reads and corrections use no external service.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New, search for ARN Smart AI-Powered Site Utilities for Elementor, then install and activate it. You can also upload the ZIP under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Make sure Elementor is installed and active.
  3. Follow ARN Utilities → Setup (it opens once after activation), or open ARN Utilities → Company Data and enter your company details.
  4. Open Elementor and find the widgets under ARN Smart Site Utilities.
  5. Turn on AI Media, SEO & Visibility, WooCommerce Tools or Smart Features only when your site needs them.
sections.faq:
Do I need Vendix Pro or a license key?

No. ARN Smart AI-Powered Site Utilities for Elementor is free, works on its own and has no license key or private updater; updates come from WordPress.org. Vendix Pro is optional and adds more widgets, Dynamic Content, store modules and priority support.

Will it slow down my site?

It is built to load only what you use. Optional modules stay inactive until you enable them, icon styles load by pack instead of the whole library, the news style sheet loads only while news widgets are on, and ARN Header Search loads no script unless live results are on.

Does it work on WordPress Multisite?

Yes. Each site of a network keeps its own settings and its own uninstall choice, and the database-wide Search & Replace is limited to Super Admins.

What happens to my data when I delete the plugin?

By default your settings and content are kept. With “Delete all Site Utilities data when the plugin is permanently uninstalled” on (ARN Utilities → Settings), Site Utilities settings, logs, analysis metadata, Header & Footer layouts and admin notes are removed, and so are form entries, push subscribers and keys, product questions, quantity tiers, order limits, read and product interest counts and correction notes, except the data that an installed ARN Smart Vendix uses too; on Multisite each site follows its own choice. The shared ARN Free AI settings, saved API keys and usage history of those sites are removed too, but only when no other installed ARN Free plugin (active or not) still uses them.

Does it send data to external services or AI?

Only when you turn on a feature that needs it, and never to an ARN server. AI Media talks only to the AI provider you set up with your own key; a Google font is downloaded once when you pick it; WooCommerce is downloaded from WordPress.org only when you click install in Guided Setup; push notifications go to your subscribers’ browser push services. AI is off by default and nothing is saved before you review it. Every service is listed under External services.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. It runs on other WordPress themes too, including classic and block themes and Elementor’s Full Width and Canvas templates. It is developed and tested with the free Vendix Theme, where every feature – header and footer places, site types and the shared design system – fits fully. Vendix Theme is also store and news ready (header search, account and cart, a plain checkout header, a news top bar, reading progress and related posts) and loads small stylesheets only where used.

Does it replace my current SEO plugin?

No. The Visibility Engine is off until you enable it and checks for another active SEO system before taking over public metadata, Schema or sitemap output. Next to another SEO plugin it can run as an analyzer only. Its content analysis checks headings, images and alt text, links and language, and the XML sitemap uses your chosen post types and taxonomies with exclusions, leaving out noindex, template and password-protected content.

Which widgets are included?

  1. ARN Advanced Heading – Builds layered headings with upper text, main text, highlighted words, lower text, multiple layout presets, decorative lines, responsive alignment, optional CTA and load/scroll highlight animation.
  2. ARN Breadcrumbs – Shows the automatic trail of the page (page hierarchy or the post’s categories) in the Minimal or Rounded Trail layout; the BreadcrumbList schema follows the trail shown.
  3. ARN Business Hours – Displays opening hours in structured rows, supports centralized company hours, open/closed presentation, responsive styling and an optional action button.
  4. ARN Button – Creates flexible CTA buttons with icons, responsive sizing, solid/outline/gradient visual styles, hover motion and optional animated backgrounds.
  5. ARN Company Information – Creates sortable company-data rows with selectable fields, custom labels, automatic links, icons and list, grid or inline layouts.
  6. ARN Contact Cards – Branch and contact cards with phone, email, address, working hours, a directions link and a button, in the Branch Cards or Compact Rows layout.
  7. ARN Counter – Animated or static numbers with prefix, suffix, decimals and a thousands separator, starting when they come into view.
  8. ARN CTA – A call-to-action box with a badge, title, text and one or two buttons on a solid or gradient background.
  9. ARN FAQ – Builds accessible accordion FAQs with multiple-open mode, open/close all control, URL hashes, keyboard navigation, configurable animation and optional FAQ Schema.
  10. ARN Feature Block – Creates service, benefit, process and feature cards with icons or images, numbers, descriptions, links, buttons, multiple layouts, equal heights and responsive columns.
  11. ARN Get in Touch – Displays address, phone, email, WhatsApp, map and social channels using centralized or custom values, with automatic links and detailed responsive styling.
  12. ARN Header Search – Adds a compact website search field or search-icon presentation suitable for Elementor headers and other page areas. With “Live results” on, products, posts and pages appear under the field while the visitor types, with keyboard and screen reader support.
  13. ARN Header Tools – Adds reusable account, wishlist and WooCommerce cart actions with optional cart count. It can be placed in any Elementor layout.
  14. ARN Hero Slider – Full-width slides with desktop and mobile images, title, subtitle, description, up to three buttons, an overlay, autoplay, fade or slide transitions, arrows and dots.
  15. ARN Icon Heading – Combines an icon or image with a title for compact service labels, feature headings and navigation-style content.
  16. ARN List Block – Builds structured icon, image or numbered lists with titles, descriptions, links, bulk entry support, responsive layouts and precise marker alignment.
  17. ARN Logo Carousel – An endless logo strip or a static grid with speed, pause on hover and focus, visible logo count and grayscale styles.
  18. ARN Navigation Menu – Displays a selected WordPress menu or your own list of custom links, with Header and Inner menu types, 10 item styles, active page highlighting, border and line colors and thickness for normal, hover and active states, dropdown support, responsive collapse controls, mobile panel behavior and keyboard-friendly interaction.
  19. ARN Post / Content Grid – The latest posts, pages or other content as Clean Cards or a Horizontal List, with excerpt, topic label, “Read more” text and an empty-state message.
  20. ARN Pricing Table – Plans with price, currency, features, a featured plan badge and a button, in the Clean Split or Featured Plan design.
  21. ARN Process / Timeline – Steps as Horizontal Steps or a Vertical Timeline, with marker content and shape settings and a connecting line.
  22. ARN Responsive Image – Uses separate desktop, tablet and mobile images with alt text, links, lazy/eager loading, fixed or natural visual slots, object fit, alignment, offsets, transforms and responsive visibility.
  23. ARN Site Logo – Displays the centralized company logo, the WordPress custom logo or a custom image with responsive sizing and linking controls.
  24. ARN Smart Text Editor – Adds rich text with an Add Shortcode selector so centralized company and legal values can be inserted directly into long-form content.
  25. ARN Team Members – Team cards with photo, role, short text and email, LinkedIn and profile links, in the Classic Cards or Compact List layout.
  26. ARN Testimonials – Customer quotes in a grid with name, role, photo, company logo, star rating and source link.
  27. ARN Announcement Bar – A bar with text, an icon and a button, in the page or sticky at the top, with its own colors; a closed bar stays closed in the visitor’s browser for the days you choose and comes back when its message changes.
  28. ARN Form – A contact form with your own fields, a notification e-mail, a thank-you message or another address after sending, and built-in spam checks (a hidden field, a minimum time, a rate limit and repeated messages). Entries are kept under ARN Utilities → Forms, with whether the notification was sent.
  29. ARN Rating Badge – A score and a review count in the Inline, Card, Pill or Platforms layout (WordPress.org, G2, Trustpilot, Google, Capterra or your own platform; you upload the logos), with stars filled to the score, numbers in the site’s format and optional AggregateRating structured data.
  30. ARN Release Notes – Versions with number, date, title and labeled items (New, Improved, Fixed, Removed, Security) in the Timeline, Cards or Compact layout, with the newest versions open, a label filter and a link to each version.
  31. ARN Section Header (news widget) – The title bar of a news section in four styles, with a subtitle and a “More” link.
  32. ARN News Blocks (news widget) – The latest posts, or the posts of chosen categories, in three newspaper layouts (lead beside a list, lead on top with a grid below, a grid of equal items), with an optional header and a link at the end.
  33. ARN News Ticker (news widget) – A breaking news band with a label and the latest headlines scrolling in a loop, with a pause button; with reduced motion it shows one headline at a time with arrows.

Which company fields, shortcodes and Dynamic Tags are available?

Fields: site name, company email and site URL; full and short company name, company logo, address, two phone numbers, WhatsApp number, working hours and map URL; legal company name, tax office and tax number, trade registry number, MERSIS or company registry ID and chamber registration number; Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, YouTube and TikTok.

Common shortcodes

  • [arnsmesu_site_name] – Website name
  • [arnsmesu_site_mail] – Company email
  • [arnsmesu_site_link] – Website URL
  • [arnsmesu_company_name] – Full company name
  • [arnsmesu_company_name_short] – Short company name
  • [arnsmesu_company_logo] – Company logo
  • [arnsmesu_company_address] – Company address
  • [arnsmesu_company_phone] – One or two linked phone numbers
  • [arnsmesu_company_whatsapp] – Linked WhatsApp number
  • [arnsmesu_company_hours] – Working hours
  • [arnsmesu_company_map] – Map link
  • [arnsmesu_company_legal_name] – Registered legal name
  • [arnsmesu_company_tax] – Tax office and tax number
  • [arnsmesu_company_trade_registry] – Trade registry number
  • [arnsmesu_company_mersis] – MERSIS or company registry ID
  • [arnsmesu_company_chamber] – Chamber registration number
  • [arnsmesu_company_social network="linkedin"] – Selected social profile
  • [arnsmesu_current_date] – Current date using the WordPress timezone and date format
  • [arnsmesu_company field="current_year"] – Current year using the WordPress timezone

Flexible shortcodes

  • [arnsmesu_company_value field="company_name" fallback="Company"] returns any supported field with an optional fallback.
  • [arnsmesu_company field="company_address" link="auto" multiline="yes"] controls fallback, linking, label, multiline output and link target.
  • [arnsmesu_company_link type="whatsapp" label="Contact us"] creates phone, email, WhatsApp, map, website or social links.

Elementor Dynamic Tags: Company Value for text controls, Company Dynamic Link for phone, email, WhatsApp, map, website and social URLs, and Company Logo for image and media controls, each with an optional fallback value.

Will renaming a media file break the pages that use it?

No. The media transaction updates supported WordPress and Elementor references, refreshes the Elementor styles of the pages that use the file and records the previous state, so you can review changes first and restore the original filename, title, slug and alt text at any time.
sections.changelog:
3.1.0

  • Added: “Live results” for ARN Header Search (off by default): products, posts and pages appear under the field while the visitor types, found with WordPress’s own search. The results work with the keyboard and screen readers (arrow keys, Home and End, Enter, Escape), and Enter without a chosen result still opens the search results page. “Number of results” sets how many are listed.
  • Changed: With “Live results” off, ARN Header Search draws the same form as before and loads no script.
  • Changed: The plugin is now named ARN Smart AI-Powered Site Utilities for Elementor. Its folder, settings and shortcodes stay the same.
  • Changed: Tested with Elementor 4.4.1.
  • Changed: The shared ARN Free AI module is updated to 1.0.6: the error message after a busy provider gives the real number of tries, the screen updates right after “Remove saved key” and “Clear usage history”, reasoning models get no temperature setting, and a key set in wp-config.php is never sent to a changed endpoint.
  • Fixed: Renaming a media file updates every stored reference more reliably, names any reference it could not update (also after Undo), and refreshes the Elementor styles of the pages that use the file, so a background image no longer points to the old address. File names in non-Latin scripts stay readable.
  • Fixed: Search & Replace ignores letter case in every language (including Turkish İ and ı), skips tables whose primary key has two columns instead of changing them, and lets only one run write at a time.
  • Fixed: Text with percent signs (such as “50%”), backslashes and non-Latin letters is kept as typed in ARN Form, product questions and answers, push notifications, the SEO box, live search, correction notes, Site Banner and Quick Menu.
  • Fixed: ARN Form and Product Questions: the rate limit counts IPv6 visitors by network and holds when two messages arrive at the same moment; deleting form entries asks for its own confirmation; product questions are deleted permanently only from Spam or Trash.
  • Fixed: SEO & Visibility Engine: JSON-LD keeps special characters safe; the SEO box and JSON-LD work on the Posts page and the Shop page; paged posts and archive pages get their own canonical URL; the social sharing preview uses the page’s real title and description; the XML sitemap leaves out the WooCommerce cart, checkout and account pages and lists shop products when no content type is chosen.
  • Fixed: When ARN Smart Contix manages a page’s SEO, the description, social tags and JSON-LD come from Contix only.
  • Fixed: Header & Footer Builder: on classic themes only the theme’s own header and footer are replaced and its page wrappers stay; nothing of the builder loads on Elementor Canvas pages; layouts can be assigned to the Posts and Shop pages; deleting a layout and Guided Setup Apply and Undo clear the page cache; the account icon of the Guided Setup store header is hidden on phones.
  • Fixed: Pricing Zones: the block cart and checkout address set the zone, quantity discount tiers and live search use the zone price, and [arnsmesu_zone_selector] prints nothing while zones are off.
  • Fixed: Product Identifiers appear on every product type and load once per row in the product list. Store Type and Product Identifiers stay out of the way without WooCommerce.
  • Fixed: Shipping on the Product Page keeps the city from the cart and sends a change made while an earlier request is running.
  • Fixed: Push Notifications: a subscription the browser’s push service has dropped is renewed, a permission prompt left unanswered is not shown again before the “Not now” period ends, the page picker keeps chosen pages and knows the Posts and Shop pages, a network-active PWA plugin’s manifest is respected, each site of a multisite network keeps its own push data, and the site’s push keys are created only once.
  • Fixed: Draft Preview Links always open their own post, send no referrer, and links made before 3.1.0 keep working until they expire.
  • Fixed: With Polylang, live search uses the page language and its “All results” link; the number of results is announced correctly for every count.
  • Fixed: Widgets: Elementor “Custom Attributes” on links in seven widgets; Business Hours highlights today on sites in any language; Responsive Image prints width and height; a linked Site Banner without alt text has an accessible label; WhatsApp numbers with the 00 prefix work; Rating Badge structured data follows the Visibility Engine; the Header Tools cart count updates with the cart and hides at zero; Post / Content Grid follows WooCommerce catalog visibility; Quick Menu groups open their first allowed link.
  • Fixed: News correction notes: fixing a note from the same box updates it instead of adding a second one, and on password-protected posts the notes show only after the password.
  • Fixed: The answer e-mail of a product question is sent only for the first answer.
  • Fixed: Uninstalling with data removal on also removes temporary locks, preview and setup data and each site’s setup reminder; deleting a site of a multisite network removes its tables.
  • Fixed: The admin screens lay out correctly in right-to-left languages, and the texts of the admin script can be translated.

Earlier versions: changelog.txt

description:
ARN Smart AI-Powered Site Utilities for Elementor is a free WordPress plugin that adds 33 Elementor widgets, a header and footer builder, SEO and schema markup, reusable company information, 3,800 icons, practical WooCommerce tools and review-first AI media to your Elementor site – in one plugin, with no license key.

Instead of five or six add-ons, you get one workspace: company details entered once appear everywhere, headers and footers follow display rules, and AI image names and alt text wait for your review. Optional modules stay off until you turn them on.

✨ Why Site Utilities?

  • Your data stays on your site – no ARN account or license server, nothing sent to ARN.
  • AI you control – your own AI provider; nothing is saved before you review it.
  • Built for every visitor – responsive, right-to-left ready and accessibility-aware output.

Build headers and footers under ARN Utilities → Header & Footer without a page builder template.

📈 SEO, Schema & Visibility Engine

Off until an administrator enables it; next to another active SEO plugin it can run as an analyzer only.

  • Metadata: SEO title, meta description, canonical, robots, focus phrases, Open Graph and X cards with a social preview.
  • Content analysis: reads the rendered page (Elementor, Gutenberg, Classic Editor, shortcodes) with a readiness score and recommendations.
  • Connected JSON-LD Schema: WebSite, Organization or LocalBusiness, WebPage, Article, Service, Product, BreadcrumbList and FAQPage.
  • XML sitemap: chosen post types and taxonomies; noindex and password-protected content is left out.

These tools improve content structure and machine understanding; they do not promise rankings or AI citations.

🏢 Company Information, shortcodes and Dynamic Tags

Enter company, contact, legal and social data once under ARN Utilities → Company Data and reuse it in widgets, shortcodes and Elementor Dynamic Tags. Change a value once and every page that uses it updates. The FAQ lists every field, shortcode and Dynamic Tag.

  • Icon search and a personal My Icons selection; Elementor’s own and Font Awesome libraries remain available.

🤖 AI Media Intelligence

Optional, disabled by default and preview-first.

  • Filename, title, slug and alt-text suggestions, one by one or in batches.
  • Renames keep content references and Elementor styles in sync; every change can be restored.
  • Optional alt text for new uploads; low-confidence suggestions go to review.

AI runs through Settings → ARN Free AI, shared by ARN Free plugins: WordPress AI (WordPress 7.0+) or your own API key for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, xAI Grok, Mistral or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Keys are stored encrypted. Without AI, suggestions come from the file name and context. If ARN Smart WebPix (Pro) manages media AI, it takes over.

🛒 WooCommerce Tools

With WooCommerce active; each tool is off by default.

  • Store Type: Physical, Virtual, Digital or Mixed; the product editor adapts.

Product schema is skipped when a dedicated SEO plugin (Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress, AIOSEO, The SEO Framework) is active, so there is no duplicate.

External services

AI Media (ARN Free AI). The plugin contacts no ARN server. AI stays off until an administrator chooses a provider and enters their own API key (stored encrypted in the database) under Settings > ARN Free AI; requests then go to that provider only.

Requests are sent only while Media Intelligence is enabled: when an administrator clicks AI Preview or Generate Selected Previews, or when automatic alt text (off by default) runs for a new upload. Sent data: the image (a copy of at most 4 MB, preferably a smaller WordPress size; SVG files are not sent) and its context: site name and tagline, file name and type, title, slug, current alt text, caption, a short description, the parent post title, the titles and short excerpts of up to three published posts that use the file, and the site language. “Test connection” (a fixed test prompt, no site content) and “Load models” (the provider’s model list) also contact the chosen provider when clicked. Nothing is sent while AI is not set up or while ARN Smart WebPix (Pro) manages media AI.

  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use , https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Anthropic (Claude): https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms , https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • DeepSeek: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html , https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
  • Moonshot AI (Kimi): https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/userprivacy
  • xAI (Grok): https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service , https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
  • Mistral AI: https://legal.mistral.ai/terms , https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/privacy-policy
  • OpenAI-compatible endpoint: the address the administrator enters, under that service’s own terms.

With WordPress AI, requests go through the provider connected in WordPress (Settings > Connectors) under that provider’s terms.

ARN Free AI keeps its settings in the arn_free_ai_settings option and daily usage totals (no prompts, answers or keys) in the {prefix}arn_free_ai_usage table.

Design System Google fonts. Only when an administrator picks a Google font for body or headings under ARN Utilities > Design System and saves, the server downloads it once: the stylesheet from fonts.googleapis.com and its WOFF2 files from fonts.gstatic.com (Latin, Latin Extended and Arabic, the Design System’s weights). Only the font family and weights are sent, no visitor or site data. The files are served from wp-content/uploads/arnsmesu-fonts, so visitors’ browsers never connect to Google. The font list comes from Elementor.

  • Google Fonts: https://developers.google.com/fonts/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy

Search & Replace. Only when an administrator uses it: “Find old addresses” sends one HTTP HEAD request for a sample file to each of at most 5 earlier site addresses found in the database, to see whether they still answer (no site data is sent); after a run or an undo, the plugin requests the site’s own home page once to detect a server or CDN page cache.

Guided Setup. Only when an administrator clicks “Install & activate” on the Plugins step of an online-store setup: WordPress’s own plugin installer downloads WooCommerce from WordPress.org, as under Plugins → Add Plugin. No other setup step uses an external service.

  • WordPress.org: https://wordpress.org/about/privacy/

Web push notifications. With Push Notifications on (Smart Features), your site itself sends each notification, encrypted, to the push service of the subscribed visitor’s browser, with no account or third-party notification service. The browser, not this plugin, picks the service:

  • Google Firebase Cloud Messaging (Chrome, Edge, Opera, Samsung Internet, Brave): https://fcm.googleapis.com — Terms: https://firebase.google.com/terms — Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Mozilla Push Service (Firefox): https://updates.push.services.mozilla.com — Terms: https://www.mozilla.org/about/legal/terms/services/ — Privacy: https://www.mozilla.org/privacy/firefox/
  • Apple Push Notification service (Safari, iPhone and iPad): https://web.push.apple.com — Privacy: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/
  • Microsoft Windows Push Notification Services (older Edge): https://*.notify.windows.com — Privacy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement

Requests are sent only when a notification goes out (a post published with “Send to subscribers when published” ticked, or a test), to the address the visitor’s browser gave when subscribing. Each carries the notification (title, text, link, image address) encrypted for that browser only, a time to live, and a signed header with your site’s public key and your site address or contact e-mail. The plugin sends no visitor IP address or other visitor personal data. Nothing is sent while the feature is off.

The Header & Footer Builder, Admin Notes, Draft Preview Links, Social Sharing Preview, ARN Form and news reads and corrections use no external service.
